description: OBSERVATIONS ONLY. Three distinct current origins support the SAME material claim but DISAGREE on direction (two report widening, one reports narrowing). Production must DERIVE an unresolved source conflict that changes the thesis and reject with no visible slot, even though origin count, freshness, owner evidence, severity, completeness and the admission score would otherwise clear. No verdict is encoded here.

hypothesis.thesis: Cross-currency funding basis stress is building this week.
hypothesis.uncertainty: Wide; origins disagree on the direction of the basis move.
hypothesis.whyNow: Multiple current origins flag a material basis move this week.
hypothesis.trigger: The basis breaches its prior wide with a directionally consistent confirmation.
hypothesis.invalidation: The basis re-anchors to its one-year median for five consecutive sessions.
hypothesis.monitoring: Track the credit-funding channel and reconcile the conflicting direction reports daily.

researchActions.detail: Reconcile the widening and narrowing origins to resolve the direction conflict.
Confirm the basis direction against a fourth independent origin.
